Yeh ahkaam Allah ki muqarrar ki hui hadein hain, halal aur haraam ke darmiyan, pas un ke qareeb bhi na jao. Jo Allah ki hadon ke qareeb jata hai, woh haraam mein girne ke qareeb hai. In ahkaam ko wazeh kar ke Allah logon par apni nishaniyan zahir karta hai, taake woh us se darein, us ke hukmon par amal karein aur us ki mana ki hui cheezein chhor dein.
188: Ek doosre ka maal na-haqq na khao: usey loot kar, zabardasti le kar, ya dhoke se; aur phir usey adalat mein le ja kar doosron ka maal na-haqq hasil karne ki koshish na karo, jab ke tum jaante ho ke Allah ne is se mana kiya hai. Jaan-boojh kar gunah karna sab se bad-tar baat hai aur sab se bare azaab ki mustahiq.
189: Aey Rasool ﷺ, woh aap se chaand ke ghatne barhne aur us ki badalti haalaton ke baare mein poochte hain. Jawab mein unhein in ki hikmat bataiye: yeh logon ke liye waqt ka pemana hain, taake woh jaan lein ke ibadat kab karni hai, jaise Hajj aur roze ke maheene aur zakaat ke liye saal ka poora hona. Yeh maamlaat ke awqaat bhi muqarrar karte hain, jaise diyat ya qarz ki ada ki miyaad. Aur yeh koi nekee aur bhalai nahin ke Hajj ya Umrah ka ihram bandh kar tum gharon mein peechhe se aao, jaisa jahiliyat ke zamane mein kaha jata tha. Asal nekee us shaks ki nekee hai jo zahir aur batin mein Allah se darta hai. Pas gharon mein un ke darwazon se aao, kyunke yeh tumhare liye zyada aasan aur kam takleef-deh hai. Allah tum par mushkil ka bojh nahin daalta. Pas neik aamaal kar ke apne aap ko Allah ke azaab se bachao, taake tum woh paa lo jis ki tamanna karte ho aur us se bach jao jis se darte ho.
190: Allah ka kalima buland karne ke liye un kafiron se laro jo tum se larte hain taake tumhein Allah ke deen se phera dein. Magar Allah ki muqarrar ki hui hadein paar na karo: bachchon, auraton aur buzurgon ko qatl kar ke, ya murdon ke aaza kaat kar, ya is tarah ke doosre kaam kar ke. Allah un logon ko pasand nahin karta jo us ki muqarrar ki hui aur mohtaram hadein paar karte hain.
191: Aur unhein wahan qatl karo jahan tum unhein pao, aur unhein wahan se nikaal do jahan se unhon ne tumhein nikala tha, yani Makkah se. Aur woh fitna jo iman walon ko ibadat se rokta hai aur unhein kufr aur na-shukri ki taraf lauta deta hai, qatl se bhi bad-tar hai. Aur Masjid-e-Haram mein un se na laro, us ki hurmat ki wajah se, siwaye is ke ke woh khud wahan tum se larna shuru karein. Agar woh Masjid-e-Haram mein larna shuru karein to unhein qatl karo. Aur agar woh Masjid-e-Haram mein hamla karein to un se larna hi haqq ko jhutlane walon ka badla hai.
192: Agar yeh hamla-awar kafir tum se larna chhor dein aur kufr chhor dein, to tum bhi un se larna chhor do. Allah us par bakshne wala hai jo nadamat ke saath us ki taraf tauba kare aur magfirat maange, aur woh us ki pichhli nafarmani par us ki giraft nahin karta. Woh un par meharban hai aur saza dene mein jaldi nahin karta.
193: Kafiron se laro yahan tak ke woh logon ko Allah ke raaste se rokna chhor dein aur kufr baaqi na rahe, aur ghalib deen Allah ka deen ho jaye. Magar agar woh apna kufr chhor dein aur doosron ko Allah ke raaste se rokna chhor dein, to un se larna chhor do. Zyadati sirf un par hai jo zulm karte hain: kufr ke zariye aur logon ko Allah ke raaste se rok kar.
194: Woh mohtaram maheena jis mein Allah ne tumhein Masjid-e-Haram mein daakhil hone aur hijrat ke saatwein saal Umrah karne ki ijazat di, woh us mohtaram maheene ka badla hai jis mein chhathe saal mushrikeen ne tumhein Masjid-e-Haram mein daakhil hone se roka tha. Mohtaram cheezon ke maamle mein, jaise Haram ki sarzameen, mohtaram maheena aur ihram ki haalat, jab hadein paar ki jayein to barabari ka usool laagu hota hai. Jab koi in mein se kisi maamle mein tum par zyadati kare, to us ke saath waisa hi karo jaisa us ne kiya, magar us se aage na barho: Allah un logon ko pasand nahin karta jo us ki hadein paar karte hain. Allah se daro aur us se aage na barho jis ki us ne ijazat di. Aur jaan lo ke Allah un logon ke saath hai jo us se darte hain: woh unhein kamiyabi deta hai aur un ki madad karta hai.
195: Apna maal Allah ki farmanbardari mein aur us ki raah mein jihad mein kharch karo, aur apne aap ko halakat mein na daalo: na jihad aur us ki raah mein kharch chhor kar, aur na apne aap ko kisi aisi cheez mein daal kar jo tumhari halakat ka sabab bane. Apni ibadat, apne maamlaat aur apne akhlaq mein ehsan aur bhalai se kaam lo. Allah un logon se mohabbat karta hai jo hamesha bhalai karte hain: woh unhein bara ajr deta hai aur unhein sachchi hidayat ki taraf le jata hai.
196: Hajj aur Umrah ko poora kar ke ada karo, sirf Allah ki razamandi chahte hue. Agar tumhein beemari ya dushman ki wajah se unhein poora karne se roka jaye, to jo qurbani ka jaanwar aasani se mil jaye woh zibah kar do, oont, gaay ya bakri, apna ihram kholne se pehle. Aur apne sar na mundao aur na baal katao jab tak qurbani ka jaanwar apni jagah na pahunch jaye. Agar tumhein Haram mein daakhil hone se roka jaye, to jahan ruke ho wahin qurbani kar do; magar agar tum daakhil ho sako, to usey qurbani ke din (10 Zul-Hijjah) ya kam az kam ayyam-e-tashreeq (11, 12 aur 13 Zul-Hijjah) mein karo. Tum mein se jo beemar ho ya jis ke sar aur baalon mein koi takleef ho, jaise joon waghairah, aur us wajah se woh sar munda le, to us par koi harj nahin; magar us ke badle woh teen din roze rakhe, ya Haram ke ilaqe ke chhe muhtajon ko khana khilaye, ya ek bakri zibah kar ke Haram ke muhtajon mein taqseem kare. Aur agar aman ka waqt ho, to jo shaks Hajj ke maheenon mein Umrah ka mauqa le aur un dono ke darmiyan woh cheezein halal kar le jo ihram mein mana hain, woh jo qurbani aasani se mil jaye woh kare: ek bakri, ya oont ya gaay ka saatwan hissa. Agar woh qurbani na kar sake, to us ke badle Hajj ke dinon mein teen roze rakhe aur ghar laut kar saat aur, kul milakar das. Umrah aur Hajj ke darmiyan yeh waqfa aur qurbani, ya qurbani na kar sakne par roze, sirf un logon ke liye hai jo Masjid-e-Haram ke Haram mein ya us ke qareeb nahin rehte. Jo Haram mein ya us ke qareeb rehte hain, woh yeh nahin karte, kyunke unhein is ki haajat nahin: woh to hamesha wahin hain aur saal ke kisi bhi waqt Umrah aur tawaf aasani se kar sakte hain. Allah se daro: us ki muqarrar ki hui shariyat ki pairwi kar ke aur us ki hadon ka ehtram kar ke. Aur jaan lo ke Allah un logon ko sakht saza dene wala hai jo us ke hukmon ki khilaf-warzi karte hain.
197: Hajj ka waqt maaloom maheene hain: Shawwal se shuru ho kar 10 Zul-Hijjah tak. Jo shaks in maheenon mein Hajj ka irada kare, ihram bandhte hi us par biwi se taalluq aur us tak le jane wali baatein haraam ho jaati hain. Is ke ilawa gunah kar ke Allah ki nafarmani ki mumaniat is waqt aur bhi sakht ho jaati hai, waqt aur jagah ki hurmat ki wajah se. Haaji kisi se jhagra na kare ke woh gusse mein aa jaye aur baat larai tak pahunche. Aur tum jo bhalai bhi karoge, Allah usey jaanta hai aur tumhein us ka ajr dega. Hajj ke liye khane-peene ka munasib saamaan le lo, magar yaad rakho ke behtareen zaad-e-raah taqwa hai. Aey aql walon, Allah se daro: us ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar.
198: Hajj ke dauran tijarat ya kisi aur jaiz tareeqe se rizq talash karne mein koi gunah nahin. Jab tum 9 Zul-Hijjah ko Arafat mein din guzaar kar wahan se chalo, aur 10 Zul-Hijjah ki raat Muzdalifah ki taraf badho, to Muzdalifah ke Mash'ar-e-Haram ke paas Allah ko yaad karo: us ki tasbeeh aur tareef karo aur us se dua karo. Aur yaad rakho ke Allah ne tumhein apne raaste ki taleem aur apne ghar ke Hajj ke aamaal ki hidayat di: is se pehle tum in ahkaam se bekhabar thay.
199: Phir Arafat se usi tarah chalo jaise Nabi Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) chalte thay, aur Arafat mein thehrna na chhoro jaisa jahiliyat ke log chhorte thay. Aur Hajj ki adaigi mein jo kami reh jaye us par Allah se magfirat maango, kyunke Allah apne un bandon par bakshne wala hai jo tauba karein, aur un par meharban hai.
200: Jab tum Hajj ke aamaal poore kar lo, to Allah ko khoob yaad karo aur us ki tareef karo, jis tarah tum apne baap-dada par fakhr karte aur un ki tareef karte ho, balke us se bhi zyada, kyunke har niyamat jo tum paate ho usi ki taraf se hai. Log alag alag hain: kuch mushrik kafir hain jo sirf isi duniya ki zindagi par iman rakhte hain. Aise log Allah se sirf is duniya ki niyamat aur us ki zeenat maangte hain, sehat, maal aur aulad ki soorat mein, aur unhein us cheez mein se kuch na milega jo Allah ne apne momin bandon ke liye aakhirat mein tayyar ki hai. Yeh is liye hai ke unhein duniya ki chaah hai aur woh aakhirat se gaafil hain.
201: Logon mein ek doosra giroh bhi hai jo Allah par aur aakhirat par iman rakhta hai. Woh apne Rubb se duniya mein bhalai aur neik aamaal ki taufeeq maangte hain, jis tarah woh us se jannat mein daakhle aur jahannum ke azaab se nijaat maangte hain.
202: Jo log duniya aur aakhirat dono ki bhalai maangte hain, unhein duniya mein un ke neik aamaal ke bare ajr ka hissa milega. Allah hisaab lene mein tez hai: woh bhalai karne walon ko ajr dega aur buraai karne walon ki giraft karega.
203: Zul-Hijjah ki gyarah, baarah aur terah tareekh ko Allah ko yaad karo: “Allahu Akbar” aur “La ilaha illallah” keh kar. Jo jaldi karna chahe, woh baarah Zul-Hijjah ko kankariyan maar kar Mina se chala jaye: is mein koi gunah nahin, kyunke Allah ne is ki ijazat di hai. Aur yeh bhi durust hai ke koi terah Zul-Hijjah ki kankariyon ke liye ruk jaye; balke yeh behtar hai aur Nabi ﷺ ka amal yahi tha. Yeh sab un logon ke liye hai jo apne Hajj mein Allah se darte hain aur usey us ke hukm ke mutabiq ada karte hain. Allah se daro: us ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar. Aur yaqeen rakho ke tum usi ki taraf lautoge aur woh tumhein tumhare aamaal ka badla dega.
204: Logon mein ek aisa shaks bhi hai jo haqeeqat mein munafiq hai, magar aey Nabi ﷺ, duniya ki zindagi ke baare mein us ki baat aap ko achhi lagti hai, aur aap us ke khoobsurat alfaz ki wajah se usey sachcha aur mukhlis samajhte hain. Magar iman ki baatein karne mein us ka maqsad sirf apni jaan aur apne maal ki hifazat hai. Woh Allah ko gawah banata hai ke us ke dil mein iman aur bhalai hai, jab ke woh jhoot bol raha hota hai: us ke dil mein Musalmanon ke liye sakht dushmani aur nafrat hai.
205: Jab yeh munafiq aap ke paas se chala jata hai, to zameen mein fasaad phailane ki koshish karta hai: gunah kar ke, khetiyan barbaad kar ke aur jaanwaron ko maar kar. Allah zameen mein fasaad ko pasand nahin karta aur na fasaad phailane walon ko pasand karta hai.
206: Jab is fasaad phailane wale ko nasihat ki jaye ke Allah se dare, us ki hadon ka ehtram kare aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bache, to us ka takabbur aur ghuroor usey tauba se rokta hai, aur woh gunah par jama rehta hai. Us ke liye sirf jahannum mein daakhla hi munasib badla hai. Aur woh apne rehne walon ke liye kitni buri jagah hai!
207: Logon mein ek aur qism bhi hai: woh momin jo apni jaan bech deta hai aur apne Rubb ki pairwi aur us ki raah mein jihad ke liye us ki razamandi chahte hue usey de deta hai. Allah ki rehmat apne bandon par bahut wasee hai aur woh un par shafeeq hai.
208: Aey woh logon jo Allah par iman rakhte ho aur us ke Rasool ki pairwi karte ho, Islam mein poore ke poore daakhil ho jao, aur us ka koi hissa na chhoro, jaisa Ahl-e-Kitab ne kiya ke kitab ke kuch hisson par iman laaye aur kuch ka inkaar kiya. Aur Shaytan ke raaston ki pairwi na karo, kyunke woh khul kar tumhara dushman hai.
209: Agar wazeh daleelein aane ke baad bhi tum phisal jao ya bhatak jao, to jaan lo ke Allah apni qudrat aur taaqat mein zabardast hai, aur apni tadbeer aur apni shariyat mein hikmat wala hai. Pas us se daro aur us ki badai bayan karo.
210: Haqq ke raaste ke bajaye Shaytan ke raaste par chalne wale yeh log sirf is ke muntazir hain ke Allah, us ki shaan ke mutabiq, qayamat ke din baadalon ke sayon mein un ke paas aaye aur un ka faisla kare, aur farishte aa kar unhein har taraf se gher lein. Us waqt Allah un ka hamesha ke liye faisla kar dega. Aur makhlooq ke tamam maamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lautte hain.
211: Aey Nabi ﷺ, Yahood se poochiye ke Allah ne unhein Rasoolon ki sachchai par kitni wazeh nishaniyan dein. Is ke bawajood unhon ne inkaar kiya aur un se munh pher liya. Aur jo shaks Allah ki niyamat ko jaan lene aur us ke wazeh hone ke baad kufr aur inkaar se badal de, to Allah kafiron aur jhutlane walon ko sakht saza dene wala hai.
212: Jin logon ne Allah ka inkaar kiya, un ke liye duniya ki zindagi aur us ki fani lazzatein aur aishein khoobsurat bana di gayin. Woh un logon ka mazaq uraate hain jo Allah aur aakhirat ke din par iman rakhte hain. Jo log Allah se darte hain, us ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar, woh aakhirat mein in se buland honge, jab Allah unhein jannat ke baagon mein basayega. Allah apni makhlooq mein se jisey chahta hai bay-hisaab deta hai.
213: Log pehle ek hi ummat thay. Woh sab ittifaq par thay aur apne baap Adam (alaihis salaam) ke raaste par hidayat-yafta thay, yahan tak ke Shaytan ne unhein gumrah kar diya. Phir woh momin aur kafir mein bant gaye. Isi liye Allah ne Rasool bheje: un logon ko Allah ki rehmat ki khushkhabri dene ke liye jo us par iman laaye aur us ki pairwi ki, aur kafiron ko Allah ke sakht azaab se daraane ke liye. Rasoolon ke saath Allah ne aisi kitabein bhi utarin jin mein woh haqq tha jis mein koi shak nahin, taake woh logon ke darmiyan un ke ikhtilafat ka faisla karein. Aur Muhammad ﷺ aur un ke paigham ke baare mein ikhtilaf sirf un logon ne kiya jinhein Taurat di gayi thi, us ke wazeh hone ke bawajood, aur yeh unhon ne zulm aur hasad se kiya. Phir Allah ne apni ijazat aur apni marzi se mominon ko hidayat aur gumrahi mein farq karne ki taufeeq di. Allah jisey chahta hai us bilkul seedhe raaste ki hidayat deta hai, aur wohi iman ka raasta hai.
214: Aey momino, kya tum samajhte ho ke tum jannat mein daakhil ho jaoge jab ke tum par woh aazmaish aayi hi nahin jo pehle logon par aayi? Woh sakht beemari aur muflisi mein mubtala hue, aur unhein aise khauf-nak waqiyaat ne hila diya ke woh chahne lage ke Allah ki madad jald se jald aa jaye; yahan tak ke Rasool aur un ke saath ke momin kehne lage: “Allah ki madad kab aayegi?” Allah ki madad un ke qareeb hai jo us par iman aur bharosa rakhte hain.
215: Aey Nabi ﷺ, aap ke sathi poochte hain ke apne maal mein se kya kharch karein aur kahan kharch karein. Jawab mein un se keh dijiye: jo halal aur paak maal tum kharch karo woh maa-baap ko do, zaroorat-mand qareebi rishtedaron ko, muhtaj yateemon ko, un muflison ko jin ke paas maal nahin, aur us musafir ko jo apne ghar walon aur apne watan se kat gaya ho. Aey momino, tum jo bhalai bhi karo, chahe kitni hi chhoti ho, Allah usey jaanta hai. Us se kuch chhupa nahin, aur woh tumhein us ka ajr dega.
216: Allah ke raaste mein jihad mominon par farz kiya gaya, agarche yeh tabiyatan na-pasandida hai, kyunke is mein jaan aur maal ka khatra hai. Magar kabhi tum kisi cheez ko na-pasand karte ho jab ke woh tumhare liye achhi aur faide-mand hai. Is ki misal Allah ke raaste mein jihad hai, jis mein bare ajr ke ilawa dushman ki shikast aur Allah ke kalime ki bulandi hai. Aur kabhi tum kisi cheez ko pasand karte ho jab ke woh tumhare liye buri aur nuqsan-deh hai, jaise jihad se ruk jana: is ka natija tumhari shikast aur dushman ka tum par ghalib aana hai. Allah khoob jaanta hai ke kya achha hai aur kya nahin, jab ke tum nahin jaante. Pas us ke hukm ki pairwi karo, jo tumhare liye behtar hai.
217: Aey Nabi ﷺ, log aap se mohtaram maheenon, Zul-Qa'dah, Zul-Hijjah, Muharram aur Rajab, mein larne ke hukm ke baare mein poochte hain. Un se keh dijiye: in maheenon mein larna Allah ke nazdeek bara jurm hai aur na-pasandida hai, jis tarah mushrikeen ka logon ko Allah ke raaste se rokna bhi na-pasandida hai. Aur mominon ko Masjid-e-Haram se rokna aur us ke rehne walon ko wahan se nikalna Allah ke nazdeek mohtaram maheene mein larne se bhi bad-tar hai. Un ka shirk qatl se bhi bad-tar hai. Mushrikeen apna zulm jaari rakhenge aur tum se larte rahenge, taake agar ho sake to tumhein tumhare haqq ke raaste se apne batil raaste ki taraf pher dein. Aur jo shaks Allah ke raaste se phir jaye aur kufr ki haalat mein mar jaye, us ke neik aamaal zaaya ho jayenge aur aakhirat mein woh jahannum ki aag mein hoga, jahan woh hamesha rahega.
218: Jo log Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman rakhte hain, apne ghar chhor kar Allah aur us ke Rasool ki taraf hijrat karte hain, aur Allah ka kalima buland karne ke liye larte hain, wohi Allah ki rehmat aur magfirat ke umeedwar hain. Allah apne bandon ke gunah bakshne wala aur un par meharban hai.
219: Aey Nabi ﷺ, aap ke sathi aap se sharab ke baare mein poochte hain, yani har us cheez ke baare mein jo aql ko dhanp le ya nasha de: ke usey peena, bechna aur khareedna kaisa hai. Aur woh jua ke baare mein bhi poochte hain, yani woh maal jo do shakson ke darmiyan muqable mein liya jaye jis mein dono daaw lagate hain. Jawab mein un se keh dijiye: in dono mein deeni aur duniyawi bahut se nuqsanat hain, jaise aql aur maal ka zaaya hona aur dushmani aur nafrat ka paida hona. Dosri taraf chand faide bhi hain, jaise jeetne wale ko maal milna. Magar un ka nuqsan aur gunah un ke faide se kahin bara hai; pas aql wale ko aise kaamon se bachna chahiye. Allah ki yeh baat sharab ki hurmat ki buniyad rakhti hai. Aur aey Nabi ﷺ, woh aap se yeh bhi poochte hain ke kitna kharch karein. Jawab mein un se keh dijiye: jo tumhari zaroorat se zyada ho aur jo aasani se ho sake. Allah apne ahkaam itni wuzahat se bayan karta hai taake tum gaur karo. Shuru mein sadqe ka yahi hukm tha; baad mein Allah ne zakaat farz ki, jis mein kuch khaas maal par, ek khaas muddat guzarne ke baad, muqarrar miqdar dena lazim hai.
220: Allah ne yeh ahkaam is liye muqarrar kiye taake tum sochо ke duniya aur aakhirat mein tumhara faida kis mein hai. Aey Nabi ﷺ, aap ke sathi aap se yateemon ki sarparasti ke baare mein poochte hain aur yeh ke un ke saath kaisa sulook karein: kya woh kharch, khane aur rehne ke liye apna maal un ke maal mein mila sakte hain? Jawab mein un se keh dijiye: agar tum un ke saath bhalai karo aur bagair kisi badle ke aur un ke maal ko haath lagaye bagair un ke maamlaat chalao, to yeh Allah ke nazdeek behtar hai aur is ka ajr bhi zyada hai. Yeh is liye bhi behtar hai ke tumhara apna maal tumhein poora milta rahega. Magar agar tum rehne-sehne ke kharch mein un ka maal apne maal mein mila lo to koi harj nahin, kyunke woh iman mein tumhare bhai hain, aur bhaiyon ka ek doosre ke maamlaat mein madad karna aam baat hai. Allah us sarparast ko bhi jaanta hai jo yateemon ka maal apne maal mein mila kar nuqsan ka irada rakhta hai, aur usey bhi jo bhalai ka irada rakhta hai. Agar woh chahta to yateemon ke maamle mein tum par tangi kar deta. Magar us ne tumhare liye aasani ki, kyunke us ki shariyat aasani par mabni hai. Allah zabardast hai, koi us par ghalib nahin aa sakta; aur woh apni tadbeer aur apni shariyat mein hikmat wala hai.
221: Aey momino, un auraton se nikah na karo jo Allah ke saath shirk karti hain, jab tak woh akele Allah par iman na le aayein aur Islam mein daakhil na ho jayein. Ek baandi jo Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman rakhti ho, us azad aurat se behtar hai jo buton ki ibadat karti ho, chahe us ka husn aur maal tumhein kitna hi bhaaye. Aur Musalman auraton ka nikah un mardon se na karo jo mushrik hain. Ek ghulam jo Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman rakhta ho, us azad mard se behtar hai jo mushrik ho, chahe woh tumhein kitna hi achha lage. Mushrik mard aur auratein apni baaton aur apne kaamon se us cheez ki taraf bulate hain jo jahannum mein le jaati hai. Aur Allah apni ijazat aur apne fazl se un neik aamaal ki taraf bulata hai jo jannat aur magfirat tak le jaate hain. Allah logon ke liye apni aayatein wazeh karta hai, taake woh sabaq lein aur us par amal karein.
222: Aey Nabi ﷺ, aap ke sathi aap se haiz ke baare mein poochte hain, yani woh khoon jo maheene ke khaas dinon mein rehm se qudrati tor par nikalta hai. Jawab mein un se keh dijiye: haiz mard aur aurat dono ke liye nuqsan-deh hai, is liye is dauran sohbat se bacho. Un ke qareeb na jao jab tak khoon band na ho jaye aur woh ghusl kar ke paak na ho jayein. Jab khoon band ho jaye aur woh paak ho jayein, to un ke paas usi raaste se jao jis ki Allah ne tumhein ijazat di hai. Allah un logon se mohabbat karta hai jo apne gunahon se baar baar tauba karte hain aur safai ka khaas ehtemam karte hain.
223: Tumhari biwiyan tumhare liye kheti hain: woh tumhare liye aulad paida karti hain, jis tarah zameen kheti ugati hai. Pas apni kheti mein jis simt se aur jis tarah chaho aao, bashart-e-ke taalluq usi jagah ho. Aur apne liye kuch bhalai aage bhejo, jaise Allah ke qurb ki niyat se aur neik aulad ki umeed se sohbat karna. Allah se daro: us ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar, jin mein auraton se mutalliq ahkaam bhi hain. Aur jaan lo ke tumhein qayamat ke din us se milna hai aur us ke saamne khara ho kar apne aamaal ka badla lena hai. Aur aey Nabi ﷺ, mominon ko un hamesha rehne wali niyamaton ki khushkhabri de dijiye jo unhein apne Rubb se mil kar zaroor khush karengi: yani us ke mubarak chehre ka deedar.
224: Allah ke naam ki qasam ko bhalai na karne ka bahana na banao, jaise us se darna, neki karna aur logon ke darmiyan sulah karana. Aur agar tum ne koi neik kaam na karne ki qasam kha li ho, to neik kaam karo aur qasam ka kaffara ada kar do. Allah tumhari baatein sunta hai aur tumhare aamaal jaanta hai, aur tumhein un ka badla dega.
225: Allah tumhari un qasmon par giraft nahin karega jo tum bay-irada kha lete ho, jaise koi be-dhyani mein keh de: “Nahin, Allah ki qasam!” ya “Haan, Allah ki qasam!” Aisi qasmon ka na koi kaffara hai aur na koi aur natija. Magar jo qasmein tum irade se khate ho, un par woh giraft karega. Allah apne bandon ke gunah bakhshta hai aur un par hilm karta hai, aur saza dene mein jaldi nahin karta.
226: Jo log apni biwiyon se sohbat na karne ki qasam kha lein, un ke liye chaar maheene se zyada ki mohlat nahin, qasam ke din se. Agar woh qasam tor kar in chaar maheenon ke andar sohbat kar lein, to Allah unhein bakhsh deta hai. Allah meharban hai aur us ne aisi qasam se nikalne ka raasta kaffare ki soorat mein rakha hai.
227: Aur agar aisa shaks apni qasam par jama rahe aur chaar maheene guzaar de, aur is se us ka irada talaq ho, to Allah un ki baatein sunta hai, talaq samet, aur un ke haalaat aur un ki niyatein jaanta hai, aur unhein us ka badla dega.
228: Talaq-yafta auratein teen haiz tak nikah na karein. Agar woh Allah aur aakhirat ke din par sachcha iman rakhti hain, to unhein jaiz nahin ke jo bachcha Allah ne un ke rehm mein paida kiya hai usey chhupayein. Un ke shauhar, jinhon ne talaq di, is iddat ke dauran unhein wapas lene ka pehla haqq rakhte hain, agar un ka irada un ke saath achhi zindagi guzarne aur talaq ke asar ko khatam karne ka ho. Auraton ke bhi usi tarah haqq aur zimmedariyan hain jis tarah shauharon ke, us tareeqe par jisey log munasib samajhte hain. Aur mardon ko un par zimmedari aur talaq ke lihaz se ek darja hasil hai. Allah zabardast hai, koi us ke faisle par ghalib nahin aa sakta; aur woh apni shariyat aur apni tadbeer mein hikmat wala hai.
229: Woh talaq jis ke baad shauhar biwi ko wapas le sakta hai, sirf do baar hai. Woh pehli baar talaq de kar wapas le sakta hai, phir doosri baar talaq de kar wapas le sakta hai. Do talaqon ke baad usey ya to usey nikah mein rakhna hoga aur us ke saath achhi zindagi guzarni hogi, ya teesri baar talaq de kar us ke haqq poore kar ke bhalai se chhorna hoga. Phir woh aurat us ke liye waqti tor par haraam ho jayegi jab tak woh kisi doosre mard se nikah na kare. Talaq ke waqt shauharon ke liye jaiz nahin ke jo mehr unhon ne apni biwiyon ko diya us mein se kuch wapas lein. Magar agar koi aurat apne shauhar ke akhlaq ya soorat ki wajah se na-khush ho, aur dono ka khayal ho ke is wajah se woh nikah ke haqq poore na kar sakenge, to woh maamla apne kisi rishtedar ya kisi aise shaks ke saamne rakhein jo unhein jaanta ho. Agar unhein lage ke yeh dono nikah ke haqq poore na kar sakenge, to is mein koi harj nahin ke aurat talaq ke badle shauhar ko kuch de de. Yeh shariyat ke ahkaam halal aur haraam ki hadein hain, pas unhein paar na karo. Aur jo Allah ki halal-o-haraam ki hadein paar karein, wohi apne aap par zulm karte hain: woh apne aap ko halakat mein daalte hain aur Allah ke gazab aur us ke insaaf ke saamne kar dete hain.
230: Agar shauhar teesri baar talaq de de, to woh us se dobara nikah nahin kar sakta jab tak woh kisi doosre mard se sahih nikah na kar le: aisa nikah jo haqeeqi ho, mehez pehle shauhar ke liye halal karne ki garz se na kiya gaya ho, aur us doosre nikah mein sohbat bhi ho chuki ho. Agar doosra shauhar usey talaq de de ya intiqal kar jaye, to woh aurat aur us ka pehla shauhar naye nikah aur naye mehr ke saath ek doosre ki taraf laut sakte hain, agar unhein lage ke woh shariyat ke muqarrar kiye hue ek doosre ke haqq poore kar sakenge. Yeh ahkaam Allah un logon ke liye wazeh karta hai jo us ke ahkaam aur us ki hadein jaante hain, kyunke wohi in se faida uthate hain.
231: Jab tum auraton ko talaq do aur un ki iddat poori hone ko aaye, to tumhein haqq hai ke unhein wapas le lo ya bhale tareeqe se chhor do yahan tak ke un ki iddat poori ho jaye. Unhein is liye wapas na lo ke unhein takleef aur nuqsan pahunchao, jaisa Islam se pehle ka dastoor tha. Aur jo unhein nuqsan pahunchane ki niyat se aisa kare, us ne apne aap par zulm kiya: us ne apne aap ko gunah aur azaab ke saamne kar diya. Aur Allah ki baaton ka mazaq aur khel na banao. Aur apne oopar Allah ki niyamatein yaad karo, sab se barh kar woh wahi jo tumhein Quran aur Sunnat ki soorat mein mili, jis ke zariye woh tumhein nasihat aur tambeeh karta hai. Allah se daro: us ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar. Aur jaan lo ke Allah har cheez jaanta hai aur us se kuch chhupa nahin. Woh tumhein tumhare aamaal ka badla dega.
232: Jab tum auraton ko teen se kam talaq do aur un ki iddat poori ho jaye, to unhein apne shauharon ki taraf naye nikah ke saath laut ne se na roko, agar woh chahein aur apne shauharon se razamand ho jayein. Rokne ki yeh mumaniat us shaks ke liye nasihat hai jo Allah aur aakhirat ke din par iman rakhta hai. Agar tum maan lo to is mein tumhare liye zyada bhalai hai, aur yeh tumhari izzat aur tumhare aamaal ko gandagi se paak rakhta hai. Allah maamlaat ki haqeeqat aur un ka anjaam jaanta hai, jab ke tum nahin jaante.
233: Jo maayein doodh pilane ki muddat poori karna chahein, woh apne bachchon ko poore do saal doodh pilayein. Us talaq-yafta maa ka nafqa aur kapra, jo bachche ko doodh pilati hai, bachche ke baap par hai, muaashre ke us dastoor ke mutabiq jo shariyat ke khilaf na ho. Kisi par us ki taaqat se zyada bojh nahin daala jata. Kisi bhi waalid ko jaiz nahin ke bachche ko doosre ko nuqsan pahunchane ka zariya banaye. Aur agar baap bina maal chhore mar jaye, to jo waris us bachche ka hota agar bachcha maal chhor kar marta, usi par wahi zimmedariyan hain jo baap par thin. Agar maa-baap do saal poore hone se pehle doodh chhurana chahein, to un par koi gunah nahin, bashart-e-ke yeh poore mashware aur is ittifaq ke baad ho ke isi mein bachche ki bhalai hai. Aur agar tum apne bachchon ke liye maaon ki jagah doodh pilane waliyan rakhna chaho, to is mein bhi koi gunah nahin, bashart-e-ke tum un ki tay-shuda ujrat bagair kami aur taakheer ke ada kar do. Allah se daro: us ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar. Aur jaan lo ke Allah tumhara har amal dekhta hai aur us se kuch chhupa nahin. Woh tumhein tumhare har amal ka badla dega.
234: Jab koi shaks mar jaye aur apne peechhe aisi biwi chhore jo hamila na ho, to us aurat par lazim hai ke chaar maheene das din intezar kare. Is dauran woh shauhar ka ghar na chhore, na bano-singar kare aur na nikah kare. Jab yeh muddat poori ho jaye, to un ke sarparaston par koi gunah nahin agar woh auratein yeh kaam karein jo iddat ke dauran mana thay: bashart-e-ke yeh muaashre aur shariyat ke munasib tareeqe par ho. Allah tumhare aamaal se khoob bakhabar hai. Tumhara koi poshida ya zahiri amal us se chhupa nahin; aur woh tumhein un ka badla dega.
235: Tum par koi gunah nahin agar tum kisi aisi aurat ko nikah ka ishara do jo talaq ya shauhar ki maut ki iddat mein ho. Misal ke tor par koi keh sakta hai: “Jab tumhari iddat poori ho jaye to mujhe bata dena.” Aur is khwahish ko apne dil mein rakhne mein bhi koi gunah nahin. Allah jaanta hai ke nikah ki shadeed khwahish ki wajah se tum un ka zikr karoge, is liye us ne tumhein khule tor par kahe bagair ishara karne ki ijazat di. Magar is se bacho ke iddat ke dauran un se chupke se nikah ka koi wada karo. Haan, munasib tareeqe se ishara kar sakte ho; magar iddat ke dauran nikah ka aqd na karo. Aur jaan lo ke jo tumhare dilon mein hai Allah usey jaanta hai, pas us se daro aur us ke hukm ki khilaf-warzi na karo. Aur jaan lo ke Allah us shaks par bakshne wala hai jo us ki taraf tauba kare; aur woh hilm wala hai aur saza dene mein aksar jaldi nahin karta.
236: Tum par koi gunah nahin agar tum apni un biwiyon ko talaq do jin se nikah to ho chuka ho magar sohbat na hui ho aur mehr bhi muqarrar na kiya gaya ho. Aisi soorat mein unhein tum se koi mehr na milega; magar unhein kuch aisi cheez zaroor di jaye jis se woh faida uthayein aur un ka dil behl jaye. Yeh maal-daar aur muflis dono apni haisiyat ke mutabiq dein. Yeh tohfa un logon par lazim hai jo apne aamaal aur apne maamlaat mein bhalai karna chahte hain.
237: Aur agar tum apni un biwiyon ko talaq do jin se sohbat se pehle hi talaq ho rahi ho, magar tum ne mehr muqarrar kar diya tha, to tumhein us ka aadha hissa unhein dena hoga, siwaye is ke ke woh apna yeh haqq chhor dein, ya shauhar poora mehr dena chahe. Apna haqq chhor dena taqwa ke zyada qareeb hai. Aur haqooq ke maamle mein ek doosre ke saath ehsan aur meharbani karna na bhoolo. Allah tumhare aamaal dekh raha hai, pas us ka ajr kamane ke liye behtareen amal karne ki koshish karo.
238: Apni namazon ki hifazat karo: unhein poora kar ke jaisa Allah ne hukm diya. Khaas kar darmiyani namaz ki hifazat karo, jo Asr ki namaz hai. Aur Allah ke saamne aajizi aur yaksoi ke saath khare ho.
239: Agar tumhein dushman ya kisi aur cheez ka khauf ho aur tum namaz poori tarah ada na kar sako, to chalte hue ya sawari par, oont, ghore ya jis tarah mumkin ho, namaz parh lo. Phir jab khauf jaata rahe, to Allah ko usi tarah yaad karo jaisa us ne tumhein sikhaya: namaz mein usey mukammal tareeqe se yaad karo. Aur isi liye bhi usey yaad karo ke us ne tumhein hidayat sikhai aur woh roshni di jis se tum pehle bekhabar thay.
240: Tum mein se jo log marte waqt apne peechhe biwiyan chhorein, unhein chahiye ke un ke liye wasiyat karein ke unhein ek saal tak rehne ki jagah aur nafqa diya jaye, aur is dauran tumhare waris unhein nikalein nahin. Yeh un ke nuqsan ki talafi aur marne wale ke ehtram ke liye hai. Aur agar woh saal poora hone se pehle apni marzi se chali jayein, to na tum par koi gunah hai aur na un par, us ke baare mein jo woh apne aap ke saath karein, jaise bano-singar. Allah zabardast hai, koi us par ghalib nahin aa sakta; aur woh apni tadbeer aur apni shariyat mein hikmat wala hai. Yaad rahe ke aksar mufassireen ki raye yeh hai ke is aayat ka hukm us aayat se mansookh ho chuka hai: “Jab koi shaks mar jaye aur apne peechhe aisi biwi chhore jo hamila na ho, to us aurat par lazim hai ke chaar maheene das din intezar kare...” [Surah Al-Baqarah: 234]
241: Talaq-yafta auraton ko kuch na kuch de kar rukhsat karna chahiye: kapra, maal waghairah. Yeh us dili takleef ki talafi hai jo unhein talaq se pahunchi. Yeh us ki haisiyat ke mutabiq ho, aur yeh un logon par haqq hai jo Allah se darte hain: us ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar.
242: Isi tarah Allah mominon ke liye apni aayatein wazeh karta hai, jin mein us ki hadein aur us ke ahkaam hain, taake woh unhein samjhein aur un par amal karein, aur is tarah duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalai paa lein.
243: Aey Nabi ﷺ, kya aap ko un logon ki khabar nahin jo maut ke khauf se, taoon ya kisi aisi hi wajah se, bari tadaad mein apne gharon se nikal gaye? Yeh Bani Israel ka ek giroh tha. Allah ne un se kaha: “Mar jao!”, aur woh mar gaye. Phir Allah ne unhein dobara zinda kiya, taake unhein dikhaye ke har cheez usi ke haath mein hai aur un ke apne ikhtiyar mein na koi faida hai aur na nuqsan. Allah logon par bara karam aur fazl karne wala hai, magar aksar log us ki niyamaton ki na-shukri karte hain.
244: Aey momino, Allah ke dushmanon se laro: us ke raaste ki madad ke liye aur us ka kalima buland karne ke liye. Aur jaan lo ke Allah tumhari baatein sunta hai aur tumhari niyatein aur tumhare aamaal jaanta hai, aur woh tumhein un ka badla dega.
245: Kaun hai jo Allah ko qarz de aur apna maal us ke raaste mein khushi se aur achhi niyat se kharch kare, taake woh usey kai guna barha kar wapas mile? Allah apni hikmat aur apne insaaf ke mutabiq rizq aur sehat mein tangi bhi karta hai aur kushadgi bhi. Aur aakhirat mein tum usi ki taraf lautoge, aur woh tumhein tumhare aamaal ka badla dega.
246: Aey Nabi ﷺ, kya aap ko Bani Israel ke un sardaron ki khabar nahin jo Moosa (alaihis salaam) ke baad hue aur apne ek Nabi se kehne lage: “Hamare liye ek baadshah muqarrar kar dijiye, hum us ke jhande tale Allah ke raaste mein larenge”? Nabi ne jawab diya: “Kya ajab ke agar Allah ne jihad farz kar diya to tum na laro!” Unhon ne is ka inkaar kiya aur zor de kar kaha: “Hum Allah ke raaste mein kyun na larte, jab ke hamare dushmanon ne humein hamare gharon se nikala aur hamare bachchon ko qaid kar liya?” Magar jab Allah ne un par jihad farz kiya to woh sab munh pher gaye, siwaye chand ke. Allah un zalimon ko jaanta hai jinhon ne apna wada tora aur us ke hukm se munh phera; aur woh unhein un ke amal ka badla dega.
247: Un ke Nabi ne un se kaha: “Allah ne Talut ko tumhara baadshah muqarrar kiya hai, jis ke jhande tale tum laroge.” Un ke sardaron ne is par eteraz kiya aur kaha: “Woh hum par kaise hukumat karega, jab ke hukumat ka haqq hum ko us se zyada hai? Woh na baadshahon ki aulad mein se hai aur na usey itna maal diya gaya hai ke apni hukumat mein kharch kare!” Un ke Nabi ne un se kaha: “Allah ne usey tum par chuna hai aur usey wasee ilm aur jismani quwwat di hai. Allah apni hikmat aur apni rehmat ke mutabiq jisey chahta hai iqtidar deta hai. Allah bara fazl karne wala hai aur jisey chahta hai deta hai. Woh jaanta hai ke us ki makhlooq mein kaun is ka zyada haqdar hai.”
248: Un ke Nabi ne un se kaha ke un ke sachche baadshah chune jane ki nishani yeh hai ke Allah unhein taboot wapas de dega. Yeh woh sandooq tha jis ki Bani Israel qadr karte thay aur jo un se le liya gaya tha. Us mein sukoon tha aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) aur Haroon (alaihis salaam) ke ghar walon ki chhori hui nishaniyan thin, jaise lathi aur kuch takhtiyan. Is mein tumhare liye wazeh nishani hai, agar tum sachche momin ho.
249: Jab Talut apne lashkar ke saath nikla to us ne un se kaha: “Allah tumhein ek nehar se aazmayega. Jo us mein se piye ga woh mere saath nahin aur mere saath jihad mein shaamil na ho. Jo us mein se na piye ga woh mere saath hai aur jihad mein mere saath shaamil hoga. Aur jo ek chullu bhar paani pi le, usey maaf hai.” Jab woh nehar par pahunche to sab ne us ka paani pi liya, siwaye chand ke jo sakht pyaas ke bawajood ruk gaye. Phir jab Talut mominon ke saath nehar paar kar gaya, to lashkar ke kuch logon ne kaha: “Aaj hum mein Jalut aur us ke lashkar se larne ki taaqat nahin.” Jin logon ko yaqeen tha ke woh qayamat ke din Allah se milenge, unhon ne kaha: “Kitni hi chhoti momin jamaatein Allah ki ijazat aur us ki madad se bari kafir jamaaton par ghalib aayi hain. Fatah iman par mabni hai, tadaad par nahin. Aur Allah apne sabr karne wale bandon ke saath hai: woh un ki madad karta hai aur unhein fatah deta hai.”
250: Jab woh Jalut aur us ke lashkar ke muqable mein nikle to unhon ne Allah se dua ki: “Aey hamare Rubb, hamare dilon mein sabr daal de, hamare qadam jama de ke hum apne dushmanon ke saamne bhaagein nahin aur himmat na haarein, aur in kafir logon ke muqable mein humein apni madad aur apni taeed ata farma.”
251: Pas unhon ne Allah ke hukm se unhein shikast di. Allah ke Nabi Dawood (alaihis salaam) ne un ke sardar Jalut ko qatl kiya, aur Allah ne unhein baadshahi aur nabuwwat di, aur jo chaha un ilm sikhaye, jin mein duniya ke faide ke bhi thay aur aakhirat ke bhi. Agar Allah ka yeh dastoor na hota ke woh kuch logon ke zariye doosron ka shar door karta hai, to zameen mein fasaad phail jata aur bure log ghalib aa jaate. Magar Allah apni tamam makhlooq par bara fazl karne wala hai.
252: Aey Nabi ﷺ, yeh Allah ki wazeh aayatein hain jo aap ko parh kar sunai jaati hain, aur in mein sachche qisse aur adl par mabni ahkaam hain. Aur beshak aap tamam jahanon ke Rubb ke Rasoolon mein se hain.
253: In Rasoolon mein se, jin ka zikr aap se kiya gaya, Allah ne baaz ko baaz par fazilat di: wahi, pairokaaron aur darjon ke lihaz se. Un mein se kuch se Allah ne baat ki, jaise Moosa (alaihis salaam); aur kuch ko buland darja diya, jaise Muhammad ﷺ, jo tamam insaniyat ki taraf aakhiri Nabi bana kar bheje gaye aur jin ki ummat ko tamam qaumon par fazilat di gayi. Aur Allah ne Isa bin Maryam (alaihis salaam) ko wazeh mojze diye jo un ki nabuwwat ki tasdeeq karte thay, jaise murdon ko zinda karna aur korhi aur paidaishi andhe ko shifa dena; aur un ki madad farishte Jibreel (alaihis salaam) se ki, taake woh Allah ke hukm ko poora karne mein quwwat payein. Agar Allah chahta to Rasoolon ke baad aane wale wazeh nishaniyan aa jane ke baad aapas mein na larte; magar unhon ne ikhtilaf kiya aur bant gaye. Un mein se kuch Allah par iman laaye aur kuch na laaye. Agar Allah chahta to woh aapas mein na larte; magar Allah jo chahta hai karta hai: woh apni rehmat aur apne fazl se jisey chahta hai iman ki hidayat deta hai, aur apne insaaf aur apni hikmat se jisey chahta hai hidayat nahin deta.
254: Aey woh logon jo Allah par iman rakhte ho aur us ke Rasool ki pairwi karte ho, qayamat ka din aane se pehle us halal maal mein se kharch karo jo Allah ne tumhein diya. Us din na koi khareed-o-farokht hogi ke koi apne kaam ki cheez khareed sake, na koi dosti kaam aayegi mushkil ke waqt, aur na koi sifarishi hoga jo kisi nuqsan se bachaye ya koi faida de, siwaye us ke jisey Allah ijazat de. Aur kafir apne is inkaar ki wajah se khud zalim hain.
255: Allah hi woh zaat hai jo yakta ibadat ke laiq hai. Wohi hai jo kaamil tor par zinda hai: us par na maut aati hai aur na koi kami. Woh apne aap se qayam hai aur apni makhlooq mein se kisi ka muhtaj nahin. Makhlooq usi se qayam hai aur hamesha us ki muhtaj hai. Us par na oongh aati hai aur na neend, kyunke us ki hayat aur us ka qayam kaamil hai. Aasmanon aur zameen ka ikhtiyar sirf usi ke paas hai. Us ke saamne koi us ki razamandi aur ijazat ke bagair sifarish nahin kar sakta. Woh jaanta hai jo guzar chuka aur jo aage aane wala hai. Makhlooq ka us ke ilm mein koi hissa nahin, siwaye us ke jo woh unhein dena chahe. Us ki kursi aasmanon aur zameen ki wusat ko ghere hue hai. Aasmanon aur zameen ki hifazat us par bhaari nahin. Woh apni zaat aur apni sifaat mein buland hai, aur apni baadshahi aur apne ikhtiyar mein azeem.
256: Kisi ko Islam mein daakhil hone par majboor nahin kiya jata, kyunke yeh khul kar sachcha deen hai aur kisi ko is par iman lane par majboor karne ki zaroorat nahin. Haqq batil se alag ho kar wazeh ho chuka hai. Aur jo un tamam cheezon ka inkaar kare jinhein Allah ke siwa pooja jata hai, aur un se bari ho jaye, aur sirf Allah par iman le aaye, us ne woh mazboot rassi thaam li jo qayamat ke din nijaat dilaayegi aur jo kabhi na tootegi. Allah apne bandon ki baatein sunta hai, un ke aamaal jaanta hai, aur unhein usi ke mutabiq badla dega.
257: Allah un logon ka kaarsaz hai jo us par iman rakhte hain. Woh unhein kamiyabi aur fatah deta hai, aur unhein kufr aur jahalat ke andheron se nikal kar iman aur ilm ki roshni mein le aata hai. Aur kafiron ke dost Shaytan aur us ke madadgar hain, jo unhein kufr khoobsurat kar ke dikhate hain aur unhein iman aur ilm ki roshni se nikal kar kufr aur jahalat ke andheron mein le jaate hain. Yahi log jahannum wale hain, jahan woh hamesha rahenge.
258: Aey Nabi ﷺ, kya aap ko us sarkash ke takabbur ki khabar hai jis ne Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) se Allah ki rububiyat aur wahdaniyat ke baare mein jhagra kiya? Yeh is liye hua ke Allah ne usey hukumat di thi, magar us ne hadd se barh kar apne martabe ka ghalat faida uthaya. Ibrahim ne usey apne Rubb ki sifaat batate hue kaha: “Mera Rubb wohi hai jo makhlooq ko zindagi deta hai aur usey maut deta hai.” Us sarkash ne hath-dharmi se kaha: “Main bhi zindagi deta hoon aur maut deta hoon. Jisey chahun qatl kar doon aur jisey chahun chhor doon.” Phir Ibrahim ne us ke saamne ek aur zyada mazboot daleel rakhi aur kaha: “Jis Rubb ki main ibadat karta hoon wohi sooraj ko mashriq se nikalta hai; pas tu usey magrib se nikal kar dikha!” Us mazboot daleel se woh sarkash hayran reh gaya aur maat kha gaya. Aur Allah zalimon ko un ki nafarmani aur sarkashi ki wajah se hidayat aur apne raaste ki taufeeq nahin deta.
259: Ya kya aap ko us shaks ki misal maloom hai jo ek aisi basti se guzra jis ki chhatein gir chuki thin, deewarein dhah chuki thin aur log mar chuke thay, aur woh ek ujra hua khandar thi? Us ne hayran ho kar kaha: “Allah in logon ko dobara kaise zinda karega?” Phir Allah ne usey sau saal ke liye maut di aur phir usey zinda kar ke poocha: “Tu kitni muddat is haal mein raha?” Us ne jawab diya: “Ek din ya us se bhi kam.” Allah ne us se kaha: “Balke tu sau saal is haal mein raha. Apne khane ko dekh, jo itni lambi muddat ke bawajood kharab nahin hua! Aur apne mare hue gadhe ko dekh! Main tujhe logon ke liye ek wazeh nishani banana chahta hoon, ke mujhe unhein dobara zinda karne ki qudrat hai. Gadhe ki bikhri hui haddiyon ko dekh. Main unhein uthaunga, jor doonga, un par gosht chadhaunga, aur phir usey zinda kar doonga.” Jab us ne yeh dekha to us par haqeeqat wazeh ho gayi aur usey Allah ki qudrat ka andaza hua, aur us ne adab se kaha: “Main jaanta hoon ke Allah har cheez par qadir hai.”
260: Aey Nabi ﷺ, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: “Aey mere Rubb, mujhe dikha de ke tu murdon ko kaise zinda karta hai.” Allah ne un se kaha: “Kya tumhein is par iman nahin?” Ibrahim ne jawab diya: “Iman to hai, magar main apne dil ka itminan chahta hoon.” Pas Allah ne unhein hukm diya: “Chaar parinde lo aur unhein apne se maanoos karo. Phir unhein tukron mein kaat do aur har parinde ka ek hissa apne aas-paas ki pahaariyon par rakh do. Phir un parindon ko pukaro, to tum dekhoge ke woh zinda ho kar jald tumhare paas chale aayenge. Aur aey Ibrahim, jaan lo ke Allah apni baadshahi mein zabardast hai aur apne hukm aur apni shariyat mein hikmat wala.”
261: Jo momin apna maal Allah ke raaste mein kharch karte hain, un ke ajr ki misal us daane jaisi hai jo kisaan zarkhez zameen mein boye. Phir us ek daane se saat baaliyan nikalti hain, aur har baali mein sau daane hote hain. Allah apne bandon mein se jis ka chahta hai ajr kai guna barha deta hai aur usey bay-hisaab deta hai. Allah bara fazl karne wala aur dene wala hai, aur woh jaanta hai ke kaun is ka haqdar hai ke us ka ajr barhaya jaye.
262: Jo log apna maal Allah ki farmanbardari aur us ki razamandi ke liye kharch karte hain, aur phir apni baaton ya apne kaamon se ehsan jata kar apna ajr barbaad nahin karte, unhein apne Rubb ke paas un ka ajr milega. Unhein aane wale ka koi khauf na hoga aur na guzre hue par koi gam, un bari niyamaton ki wajah se jo woh paa rahe honge.
263: Ek achhi baat jo kisi momin ko khush kar de, ya kisi bad-akhlaq shaks se darguzar, us sadqe se behtar hai jis ke baad ehsan jata kar takleef di jaye. Allah apne bandon se be-niyaz hai; aur kyunke woh un par hilm karta hai, is liye woh saza dene mein aksar jaldi nahin karta.
264: Aey woh logon jo Allah par iman rakhte ho aur us ke Rasool ki pairwi karte ho, apne sadqe ka ajr ehsan jata kar aur lene wale ko takleef de kar barbaad na karo. Aisa karne wala us shaks jaisa hai jo logon ko dikhane aur un se tareef sunne ke liye kharch karta hai, aur Allah par aur qayamat ke din ke ajr aur azaab par iman nahin rakhta. Is ki misal us chikne patthar jaisi hai jis par kuch mitti ho: jab us par tez baarish parti hai to mitti bah jaati hai aur patthar saaf ka saaf reh jata hai, us par kuch nahin bachta. Isi tarah dikhawa karne walon ke aamaal aur un ke sadqe ka ajr Allah ke nazdeek baaqi nahin rehta. Aur Allah kafiron ko us cheez ki hidayat nahin deta jo usey khush kare aur un ke aamaal aur un ke kharch mein unhein faida de.
265: Aur jo momin apna maal Allah ki razamandi chahte hue kharch karte hain, apne dilon mein Allah ke wade ka pakka yaqeen rakhte hue, un ki misal us baag jaisi hai jo kisi buland zarkhez zameen par ho aur us par tez baarish pare, to woh apni paidawar dugni kar de. Aur agar us par tez baarish na pare to halki phuwar bhi us ke liye kaafi hai, kyunke zameen zarkhez hai. Isi tarah mukhliseen jo thora bhi kharch karte hain, Allah usey qabool karta hai aur us ka ajr kai guna kar deta hai. Allah tumhare aamaal dekh raha hai: woh jaanta hai ke kaun mukhlis hai aur kaun nahin, aur woh har ek ko usi ke mutabiq badla dega.
266: Kya tum mein se koi yeh chahta hai ke us ka ek aisa baag ho jis mein khajoor aur angoor ke darakht hon, jis ke beech meethe paani ki nehrein behti hon, aur jis mein har qism ke umda phal hon? Phir jab baag ka maalik boorha ho jaye, kaam aur kamai ke qabil na rahe, aur us ke chhote kamzor bachche bhi hon jo kaam nahin kar sakte, to is baag par ek tez aag wali aandhi aaye aur woh poora jal jaye, us waqt jab usey us ki sab se zyada zaroorat ho, apne burhape ki wajah se aur apne chhote kamzor bachchon ke liye. Us shaks ka haal isi aadmi jaisa hai jo logon ko dikhane ke liye apna maal kharch karta hai: jab woh qayamat ke din Allah ke saamne aayega to us ke paas koi neik amal na hoga, us waqt jab usey un ki sab se zyada zaroorat hogi. Isi tarah Allah tumhare liye wazeh karta hai ke duniya aur aakhirat mein tumhara faida kis mein hai, taake tum gaur karo.
267: Aey woh logon jo Allah par iman rakhte ho aur us ke Rasool ki pairwi karte ho, apni kamai ke paak aur umda maal mein se kharch karo, aur us paidawar mein se bhi jo hum ne tumhare liye zameen se nikali. Aur kharch karne ke liye ghatiya cheez na chuno, kyunke agar wohi tumhein di jaye to tum apni khushi se na lete, us ki kharabi ki wajah se. Phir tum is par kaise raazi ho jaate ho ke Allah ko woh cheez do jo tum khud apne liye qabool na karte? Aur jaan lo ke Allah tumhare kharch se be-niyaz hai, aur woh apni zaat aur apne kaamon mein tareef ke laiq hai.
268: Shaytan tumhein muflisi se darata hai aur bakheeli par ubharta hai, aur tumhein gunahon ki taraf bulata hai. Aur Allah tum se apne gunahon ki magfirat aur bay-shumaar rizq ka wada karta hai. Allah bara fazl karne wala hai aur apne bandon ke haal ko jaanta hai.
269: Allah apne bandon mein se jisey chahta hai yeh taufeeq deta hai ke us ki baat aur us ka amal durust ho. Aur jisey yeh taufeeq mil gayi, usey bahut bari bhalai mil gayi. Magar nasihat sirf wohi log pakarte hain aur Allah ki nishaniyon se wohi faida uthate hain jo aql rakhte hain, aur jo us ki roshni se roshni aur us ki hidayat se hidayat talash karte hain.
270: Tum jo kuch bhi kharch karo, chahe kitna hi thora ho, Allah ki razamandi ke liye; ya jo nazr tum Allah ke liye maano jab ke woh tum par lazim na thi, Allah usey jaanta hai aur woh zaaya na hoga. Woh tumhein us ka bara ajr dega. Aur jo log apni zimmedariyan poori na kar ke aur Allah ki hadein paar kar ke zulm karte hain, un ka qayamat ke din azaab se bachane wala koi na hoga.
271: Agar tum apne sadqe khul kar do to yeh achha kaam hai. Magar agar tum unhein chhupa kar muhtajon ko do to yeh behtar hai, kyunke is mein khulus zyada hai. Aur jo sadqa khulus se diya jaye woh gunahon ke dhanpne aur maaf hone ka zariya banta hai. Allah tumhare aamaal jaanta hai aur tumhare haalaat mein se kuch us se chhupa nahin.
272: Aey Nabi ﷺ, aap ke zimme yeh nahin ke unhein haqq par iman aur us ke saamne jhukne par le aayein: aap ka kaam sirf unhein haqq ki hidayat dena aur usey wazeh karna hai. Unhein haqq tak Allah hi pahuncha sakta hai; aur woh jisey chahta hai hidayat deta hai. Aur jo bhalai tum kharch karo us ka faida tumhein hi lautta hai; Allah usey be-niyaz hai. Pas tumhara kharch sirf Allah ke liye ho: sachche momin sirf Allah ki razamandi ke liye kharch karte hain. Aur jo bhalai tum kharch karoge, chahe kitni hi thori ho, us ka poora ajr tumhein milega, kyunke Allah kisi par zulm nahin karta.
273: Kharch un muhtajon par karna chahiye jo Allah ke raaste mein jihad mein mashgool hone ki wajah se kamai ke liye safar nahin kar sakte. Un ke na maangne ki wajah se be-khabar shaks unhein maal-daar samajhta hai. Magar jo jaanta hai woh unhein un ke jism aur un ke kapron par zahir alamaton se pehchan leta hai. Woh un doosre muhtajon jaise nahin jo lipat kar maangte hain. Aur tum jo bhalai ya maal bhi kharch karo, Allah usey jaanta hai aur tumhein us ka bara ajr dega.
274: Jo log apna maal Allah ke liye kharch karte hain, raat ko bhi aur din ko bhi, chhupa kar bhi aur khul kar bhi, bagair dikhawe aur shohrat ki chaah ke, unhein qayamat ke din apne Rubb ke paas un ka ajr milega. Allah ke fazl aur us ki niyamat se unhein aane wale ka koi khauf na hoga, aur na us par koi gam jo duniya mein un se chhoot gaya.
275: Jo log sood lete hain, woh qayamat ke din apni qabron se us shaks ki tarah uthenge jisey Shaytan ne chhoo liya ho: woh apni qabron se khare honge aur phir mirgi wale ki tarah gir parenge. Yeh is liye ke unhon ne sood ko halal thehraya aur sood aur us nafe mein koi farq na kiya jo Allah ne khareed-o-farokht mein halal kiya hai. Unhon ne kaha: “Beh bhi to sood hi jaisa hai”, yani dono halal hain kyunke dono se maal barhta hai. Allah un ka yeh qiyas radd karta hai aur wazeh karta hai ke us ne beh ko us ke aam aur khaas faidon ki wajah se halal kiya, aur sood ko haraam kiya kyunke woh zulm hai aur logon ka maal na-haqq khana hai. Aur jo shaks Allah ka hukm aur us ki tambeeh pahunchne ke baad sood lena chhor de aur apne gunah se tauba kar le, woh pehle liya hua sood apne paas rakh sakta hai aur us par koi gunah nahin. Phir is ke baad woh jo kare, us ka faisla Allah karega. Aur jo hurmat jaan lene ke baad phir sood ki taraf laute, woh jahannum mein daakhil hone aur us mein hamesha rehne ka mustahiq hai. Allah ki wahdaniyat par iman rakhne walon ke liye jahannum mein hamesha rehne ka zikr lambi muddat ki taraf ishara hai; kyunke hamesha ke liye jahannum mein sirf kafir hi rahenge.
276: Allah sood ko mita deta hai: ya to usey haqeeqatan barbaad kar ke, ya us se apni barkat uthaa kar. Aur sadqe ko woh barhata hai: us ka ajr das guna se le kar saat sau guna, balke us se bhi zyada kar deta hai, aur sadqa dene walon ke maal mein barkat daalta hai. Allah us hath-dharm kafir se mohabbat nahin karta jo haraam ko halal samjhe aur gunahon par jama rahe.
277: Jo log Allah par iman rakhte hain, us ke Rasool ki pairwi karte hain, neik aamaal karte hain, namaz poori tarah ada karte hain aur zakaat us ke haqdaron ko dete hain, unhein apne Rubb ke paas un ka ajr milega. Unhein aane wale ka koi khauf na hoga aur na us par koi gam jo duniya ki zindagi mein un se chhoot gaya.
278: Aey woh logon jo Allah par iman rakhte ho aur us ke Rasool ki pairwi karte ho, Allah se daro: us ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar. Aur jo sood logon ke zimme tumhara baaqi hai, usey na maango, agar tum waqai Allah par aur us ki muqarrar ki hui hurmat par iman rakhte ho.
279: Aur agar tum is hukm par amal na karo, to Allah aur us ke Rasool se jang ke liye tayyar ho jao. Aur agar tum Allah ki taraf tauba karo aur sood chhor do, to tumhara asal sarmaya tumhara hai: na tum kisi par zulm karo ke apne asal se zyada lo, aur na tum par zulm kiya jaye ke tumhein apne asal se kam mile.
280: Aur agar jis se tum apna qarz maangte ho woh tangi mein ho aur ada na kar sake, to intezar karo yahan tak ke us ke paas maal aa jaye aur woh qarz ada kar de. Aur yeh ke tum usey sadqa kar do, qarz na maango ya us ka kuch hissa chhor do, tumhare liye behtar hai, agar tum jaano ke Allah ke nazdeek is ki kya qadr hai.
281: Us din ke azaab se daro jis mein tum sab Allah ki taraf lautaye jaoge aur us ke saamne khare hoge. Phir har shaks ko us ke har neik ya bure amal ka badla diya jayega. Un par zulm na kiya jayega: na un ke neik aamaal se kam ajr milega aur na un ke bure aamaal se zyada saza.
282: Aey woh logon jo Allah par iman rakhte ho aur us ke Rasool ki pairwi karte ho, jab tum udhaar ka koi maamla karo, jaise ek doosre ko muqarrar muddat ke liye qarz do, to usey likh lo. Jo shaks likhna jaanta ho woh insaaf aur shariyat ke mutabiq likhe, aur likhne se inkaar na kare, kyunke Allah ne usey adl ke saath likhna sikhaya hai. Woh wohi likhe jo woh shaks bolwaye jis ke zimme haqq hai, taake yeh us ka iqrar bane. Aur usey Allah se darna chahiye aur qarz ki miqdar ya us ki tafseel mein kuch kam na karna chahiye. Agar maqrooz maamlaat ka tajurba na rakhta ho, ya nabalig ho, ya diwana ho, ya goonga hone ya kisi aur wajah se bolwa na sakta ho, to us ka mujaz sarparast insaaf ke saath bolwaye. Aur do aqlmand aur mautabar mardon ko gawah bana lo. Agar do mard na milein to ek mard aur do auratein, jin ke deen aur jin ki diyanat se tum mutmain ho, taake agar ek aurat bhool jaye to doosri usey yaad dila de. Gawah ko gawahi se inkaar nahin karna chahiye, aur talab kiye jane par gawahi deni chahiye. Aur qarz likhne mein susti na karo, chahe raqam kitni hi chhoti ho; yeh Allah ki shariyat mein zyada insaaf wali baat hai, gawahi ke liye zyada mazboot hai, aur qarz ki qism, miqdar ya muddat ke baare mein shak door karne ke liye zyada munasib. Haan, agar maamla maujood maal ka naqd sauda ho, to usey na likhne mein koi harj nahin, kyunke is ki zaroorat nahin. Aur gawah banane ka hukm is liye diya gaya ke jhagre na uthein. Gawahon aur likhne walon ko nuqsan pahunchana haraam hai; aur unhein bhi un logon ko nuqsan nahin pahunchana chahiye jo unhein likhne ya gawahi dene ko kehte hain. Aur jo nuqsan pahunchaye, woh Allah ki shariyat se nikal gaya. Aey iman walon, Allah se daro: us ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar. Allah tumhein woh sikhayega jo duniya aur aakhirat mein tumhare liye behtar hai. Allah har cheez jaanta hai aur us se kuch chhupa nahin.
283: Aur agar tum safar mein ho aur koi aisa shaks na milay jo tumhara qarz likh de, to maqrooz apne haqq ki zamanat ke tor par qarz-khwah ko koi cheez girvi de sakta hai, jab tak qarz ada na ho jaye. Aur agar tum ek doosre par bharosa karte ho, to likhna, gawah banana ya girvi dena zaroori nahin. Aisi soorat mein qarz maqrooz ki zimmedari hai, jisey usey poora karna chahiye aur is maamle mein Allah se darna chahiye ke baad mein us ka inkaar na kare. Aur agar woh baad mein inkaar kare, to jo shaks us maamle ke waqt maujood tha usey gawahi deni chahiye aur usey chhupana nahin chahiye. Aur jo gawahi chhupaye, to is ka matlab yeh hai ke us ka dil gunahgar hai. Allah tumhare aamaal jaanta hai, us se kuch chhupa nahin, aur woh tumhein tumhare aamaal ka badla dega.
284: Aasmanon aur zameen ki har cheez Allah hi ki hai: usi ne sab paida ki, usi ki milkiyat hai, aur usi ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Tum apne dilon ki baat zahir karo ya chhupao, Allah usey jaanta hai aur us ka hisaab lega. Phir woh apne fazl aur apni rehmat se jisey chahega maaf kar dega, aur apni hikmat aur apne insaaf se jisey chahega saza dega. Aur Allah har cheez par qadir hai.
285: Nabi Muhammad ﷺ us har cheez par iman rakhte hain jo un ke Rubb ki taraf se un par utari gayi, aur momin bhi. Yeh sab Allah par, us ke tamam farishton par, un tamam kitabon par jo us ne Nabiyon par utarin, aur un tamam Rasoolon par iman rakhte hain jinhein us ne bheja. Woh in Rasoolon par bagair kisi farq ke iman rakhte hain. Woh kehte hain: “Hum ne tere hukm aur teri mana ki hui baatein sun lin, aur hum teri farmanbardari karte hain: tere hukmon par amal kar ke aur teri mana ki hui cheezein chhor kar. Aey hamare Rubb, hum tujh se magfirat maangte hain, kyunke hum apne har maamle mein sirf teri hi taraf laut te hain.”
286: Allah kisi par sirf utna hi bojh daalta hai jitna woh utha sake. Allah ka deen aasani par mabni hai, mushkil par nahin. Jo shaks koi bhalai kare, usey us ka poora ajr milega. Aur jo koi buraai kare, usey apne kiye hue gunah ki saza milegi aur koi doosra usey nahin uthayega. Rasool aur mominon ne kaha: “Aey hamare Rubb, agar hum bhool jayein ya bagair irade ke koi baat kehne ya karne mein galti kar baithein, to hum par giraft na kar. Aey hamare Rubb, hum par aisa bojh na daal jo hamare liye mushkil ho aur jise hum utha na sakein, jaisa tu ne hum se pehle logon par daala tha jinhein un ke zulm par saza mili. Aur humein aise hukm aur aisi mumaniatein na de jo hamare liye mushkil hon aur jinhein hum poora na kar sakein. Apne fazl se hamare gunahon se darguzar farma, humein bakhsh de aur hum par reham kar. Tu hi hamara kaarsaz aur madadgar hai, pas humein kafir qaum par fatah ata farma.”
